title: Proper qcqs integral-to-rational scalar comparison with the counit normalization
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in a fixed algebraic closure, $A=\mathcal O_F$ with its induced norm topology, and either a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ containing $F$ with $\Lambda=E$, or $\Lambda=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with the induced norm topology and all continuous functions, as in [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Let $h:U\to V$ be a proper morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Use $A_W=p_W^*\underline A$, $\Lambda_W=p_W^*\underline\Lambda$, the ordinary unbounded derived module-object categories [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], and $T_W=\Lambda_W\otimes^L_{A_W}-$ in the universe [def-weil-size-convention]. For every $J\in\mathrm D_{\mathrm{ctf}}(U,A)$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible], the canonical coefficient-change map
$$\rho_{h,J}:T_V Rh_{*,A}J\longrightarrow Rh_{*,\Lambda}T_UJ$$
is an isomorphism. Its definition is the transpose under $h_\Lambda^*\dashv Rh_{*,\Lambda}$ of
$$h_\Lambda^*T_V Rh_{*,A}J\xrightarrow{\sim}T_U h_A^*Rh_{*,A}J\xrightarrow{T_U(\varepsilon_{h,A,J})}T_UJ,$$
where the first arrow is the inverse of the scalar/pullback mate of [lem-sfb-kflat-scalar-comparison-normalization], transported by the canonical section-module equivalences [lem-sfb-internal-module-operations-transport]. In particular this is the coefficient projection map with its specified counit, not an unspecified isomorphism between these objects. No geometric base-change assertion and no Noetherian, characteristic, dimension or invertibility-of-$\ell$ hypothesis is included.

source.place: (2), scalar extension in the proper closed-complement calculation. Agent proper coefficient projection lemma for this qcqs finite-model scope. The full all-continuous norm-topological clause is not attributed to a finite-subextension-valued coefficient comparison or to the colimit-topological algebraic closure.
